final: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID AS ID, P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS pt, AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS d FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(d) AS md FROM p) SELECT p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(p.pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(p.d) AS avg_iga_minus_igm, AVG(p.d / m.md) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM p CROSS JOIN m GROUP BY p.SEX
